answer: Scarce seals: only 50 live verification slots open each day, and a key needs a seal fresher than 7 days to earn. At most 50×7=350 keys stay active, so a farm of 1,000 is cut at the shale line to 350. Seals clear a burn auction; if the price is 2 and pay is 0.4/day, seven days return 2.8, a thin 0.8 that funds no extras. An honest agent books one calendar thread; a marble row of alts finds no second seat.
